instruction: Create a new 640x480 pixel image in GIMP and export it as a PNG file to the Desktop named 'new_image.png'.

metadata.trajectory_summary: Agent attempted to download HKU logo using GIMP's Open Location feature. Tried multiple Wikipedia URLs but GIMP hung on 'Mounting remote volume' each time. GIMP became unresponsive repeatedly. Model never recognized the task as infeasible and spent all 50 turns trying different URLs.
metadata.capability_extraction: Can launch GIMP from application menu, navigate GIMP menus (File, Edit, Filters), use File > Open Location dialog, type URLs into dialogs, handle 'not responding' dialogs, browse Filters menu categories
metadata.failure_analysis: Model failed to recognize the task as infeasible. The task asked to download a logo using only GIMP built-in features without a browser, which is not reliably possible. Model kept trying URLs via Open Location, causing GIMP to hang on remote volume mounting.
metadata.task_rationale: Decomposed to a basic GIMP image creation task within the model's demonstrated ability to navigate GIMP menus. Creating a new image with specific dimensions tests File > New dialog interaction.
metadata.explanation: Task requires creating a new image with specific dimensions in GIMP and exporting it. Evaluator uses existing check_image_size metric to verify the exported file has correct 640x480 dimensions.

llm_judge_reasons: Getter (vm_file) correctly fetches the exported PNG from /home/user/Desktop/new_image.png, matching the instruction's required filename and location.
Metric (check_image_size) correctly receives the rules dict {width: 640, height: 480} via the 'rule' expected type and compares against the actual image dimensions using PIL.
All instruction requirements are covered: file existence (implicit via PIL open), correct path/name (via getter path), and correct 640x480 dimensions (via metric check).
Expected values (width=640, height=480) exactly match the instruction requirements.
